```{r}
rm(list = ls(all = TRUE)) # Clear workspace

library(imputeTS)     # To impute
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

# data Kalmann (based on older export, complete apart from B23)
KalDir<-""
load(paste0(KalDir, "kalmann.RData"))

# load newest export tb data
DataDir<-""
OutDir<-""

# Terugblik data 
load(paste0(DataDir, "data_terugblik.RData"))
table(tb$Studienummer)
```

# clean an empty trailing end
```{r}
tb<-tb[!tb$Studienummer %in% c("B18", "B19"),] # remove the participants without end date
table(tb$Completed) # all completed

# remove trailing end 
tb <- tb %>%
  group_by(Studienummer) %>%
  arrange(sent, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  filter({
    # Identify rows that meet removal criteria
    candidate <- is.na(start)
    
    # For each candidate row, check if any non-NA start exists after it
    has_future_start <- sapply(seq_along(start), function(i) {
      if (!candidate[i]) return(TRUE)  # not a candidate, keep it
      any(!is.na(start[(i + 1):length(start)]))  # TRUE if a future start exists
    })
    
    # Keep row if: not a candidate, OR has a future non-NA start
    !candidate | has_future_start
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

```


```{r}
tb<-tb %>% rename(
```

# function for imputation
```{r}
plot_kalman_imputation <- function(df, Participant) {
  
  # Imputation
  df$fse_imp          <- na_kalman(df$fse,          model = "StructTS", smooth = TRUE, maxgap = Inf)
  df$health_imp       <- na_kalman(df$health,       model = "StructTS", smooth = TRUE, maxgap = Inf)
  df$satisfaction_imp <- na_kalman(df$satisfaction, model = "StructTS", smooth = TRUE, maxgap = Inf)
  
  # Reshape
  df_long <- df %>%
    mutate(
      fse_missing          = is.na(fse),
      health_missing       = is.na(health),
      satisfaction_missing = is.na(satisfaction)
      
    ) %>%
    select(sent,
           fse_imp, fse_missing,
          health_imp, health_missing,
           satisfaction_imp, satisfaction_missing
          ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(fse_imp, health_imp, satisfaction_imp),
      names_to = "variable",
      values_to = "value"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      missing = case_when(
        variable == "fse_imp"          ~ fse_missing,
          variable == "health_imp"       ~ health_missing,
        variable == "satisfaction_imp" ~ satisfaction_missing
      ),
      variable = recode(variable,
        fse_imp          = "Fatigue-related self-efficacy (FSE)",
        health_imp       = "Perceived health",
        satisfaction_imp = "Life Satisfaction"
  
      )
    )
  
  # Plot
  p <- ggplot(df_long, aes(x = sent, y = value)) +
    geom_line(colour = "blue") +
    geom_point(colour="blue") + 
    geom_point(
      data = filter(df_long, missing),
      colour = "red", size = 1
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~ variable, ncol = 3, scales = "free_y") +
    labs(
      x     = "Time",
      y     = "Value",
      title = paste("Kalman Imputation —", Participant)
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
    )
  
  list(data = df, plot = p)
}
```

```{r}
B01<-tb[tb$Studienummer=="B01",]

result <- plot_kalman_imputation(B01, unique(B01$Participant))
B01    <- result$data
result$plot

ggsave(paste0(OutDir, "1_Imputation/2026-04-21_B01_imp.jpeg"), plot = result$plot, width = 10, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

# correct the phase A and B vars for B23
```{r}
# create a time var for everyone
tb_imp <- tb_imp %>%
  arrange(Studienummer, sent)
# make sure ordered in time
tb_imp %>%
  group_by(Studienummer) %>%
  summarise(is_sorted = all(diff(sent) >= 0))


tb_imp <- tb_imp %>%
  group_by(Studienummer) %>%
  mutate(time = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()


tb_imp<- tb_imp %>%
  group_by(Studienummer) %>%
#  arrange(time, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    ref_time = {
      idx <- which(phase_FSE == "B")
      if (length(idx) == 0) NA_real_ else time[min(idx)]
    }
  )

tb_imp <- tb_imp %>%
  group_by(Studienummer) %>%
    mutate(
      phase_cis4_school = if_else(
      time < ref_time + 28, "A", "B"
    ),

    phase_satisf_health = if_else(
      time < ref_time + 42, "A", "B"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```
